prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 82.3%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 79.7%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 67.6%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_flow] Pick friend interactive preview flow: Transform pet selection into an interactive preview flow with animated mascot actions and audio feedback. (why: Adoption has a high drop-off with only 67.6% conversion and mean time over 1000s.)
1: [home, new_screen] Desktop display permission prep screen: Insert a new screen 'new_desktop_prep' before waiting to guide window render permissions before spawning. (why: 3 support tickets mentioned pet not showing on desktop or app failing to open.)
2: [adoption, copy] Custom photo fallback assurance copy: Update upload_photos copy to reassure users that a standard mascot will be generated if custom photo processing encounters issues. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected visuals.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Sign-in multi-device pet sync hint: Add a prominent hint below sign-in options explicitly stating that signing in merges existing pet save files. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing back in.)
4: [home, wait_info] Waiting screen sound preview component: Add an interactive sound preview component and active time estimate on the waiting screen. (why: Home waiting phase takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, driving user drop-off.)
5: [finish, layout] Centered home intro launcher layout: Switch home_intro to a centered layout with an explicit launch CTA button. (why: Finish step drops off significantly at 64.8% with an excessively long mean duration of 5815s.)
